description: This file defines the Returns model class for handling sale return operations in the Opencart admin module. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting returns, managing return histories, and fetching return data with filters.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: A class managing CRUD operations and histories for product returns within the Opencart admin sale module.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Creates a new return record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editReturn
methods.description: Updates an existing return record identified by return_id with new data.

methods.name: editReturnStatusId
methods.description: Updates the status of a return identified by return_id.

methods.name: deleteReturn
methods.description: Deletes a return record and its histories from the database.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific return by return_id.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Fetches a list of returns applying optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Counts the total number of return records matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Counts returns with a specific return status ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnReasonId
methods.description: Counts returns linked to a specific reason ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnActionId
methods.description: Counts returns associated with a specific action ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a status change entry to a return's history, optionally notifying the customer.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes all history records for a specific return.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves history entries for a specific return, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for a specific return.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Counts total history entries filtered by return status ID.
